# units/gib

> n gib: gibibytes: 1024 mib, as bytes.

truck [units](../units.md) · [source](../../../registry/units/gib.pkg)

```
print 2 gib  // 2147483648
```

Binds tighter than any operator, so `2 * 3 gib` is `2 * (3 gib)`.
See [units](../units.md).

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative

```
{n: expr int} gib -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `n` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`

## Needs

- [std/mul](../std/mul.md)

## Expands to

This package has no backend: each use is rewritten to the following
source, with `{slot}` replaced by what was written there, and compiled again.

```
{n} * 1073741824
```
